_comment: DESIGN.md §9. Nine normal monsters spanning all four armour types, plus four bosses - one per armour type, drawn at random on boss waves (§3.4). All placeholders.

bosses.name: Brood Sire
bosses._note: §3.4 wants a boss to carry a MIX of armour types across its parts or spawns so no single damage type hard-counters it. This one is single-armour - that needs a multi-part boss model which does not exist yet. The bank spreads the four armour types across four bosses as a stopgap.
